acceptance_test: Geometry edge_on_share in the orbit 0.3-0.5 with hero covers frontal; owner compares against the reference phase sheet.
candidate_rule:
problem: Covers that mostly face the camera read flat even when their depths differ.
implementation: Give the orbit a wide orientation distribution (a share of covers within ~20° of edge-on) and reserve frontal faces for heroes.
use_when: Orbit phases whose job is depth, not cover legibility.
avoid_when: Beats where individual covers must be recognised.
cause_hypothesis: [implementation; unvalidated] yaw/pitch offsets of ±34°/±20° around a radial facing keep faces readable but remove the sliver/face contrast that carries depth in the reference.
problem_evidence: Geometry: only 13-15 % of visible covers are near edge-on (|facing|<0.25) during the orbit in all variants; most covers face the lens. Local-only phase sheet reference-runs/apple-music/phase2-phase-comparison-LOCAL-ONLY.jpg (not committed, third-party frames) shows the reference wreath dominated by steeply tilted, small covers.
